source_refs.note: Book p. 36-37: 3.2 Inverse of Quadratic Function and Example 4 (domain and range); callouts marked Teaching note / Key points / Common mistake and the Book correction boxes are ours.

blocks.text: Unit 2 mein aap ne seekha tha ke kisi function ka inverse tabhi hota hai jab woh one-to-one ho, yani har output sirf ek input se aaye. Aaj hum dekhenge ke quadratic function ke saath yahan ek masla hai, aur us ka hal kya hai.

Quadratic functions aam tor par apne poore domain par one-to-one nahi hote. Quadratic function ka inverse nikalne ke liye humein us ka domain kisi aise hisse tak mehdood (restrict) karna parta hai jahan woh one-to-one ho. Aam tor par domain ko \(x \ge h\) (jahan \(h\) vertex ka \(x\)-coordinate hai) ya \(x \le h\) tak mehdood karte hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Quadratic function one-to-one kyun nahi? Is ki symmetry ki wajah se. Axis \(x = h\) se barabar faasle par do mukhtalif inputs ek hi output dete hain. Misaal: \(f(x) = x^{2} + 4x + 3\) mein \(f(-3) = 9 - 12 + 3 = 0\) aur \(f(-1) = 1 - 4 + 3 = 0\). Ab agar inverse ho to use 0 ko wapas \(-3\) bhi bhejna hoga aur \(-1\) bhi, aur function ek input ke do output nahi de sakta.
Horizontal line test (Unit 2 se): koi horizontal line parabola ko do points par kaatti hai, is liye poora parabola test fail kar deta hai. Lekin agar parabola ko vertex se kaat kar sirf ek baazu (arm) rakhein, to har horizontal line use zyada se zyada ek dafa kaatti hai.
Yani: ek baazu (\(x \ge h\) ya \(x \le h\)) = one-to-one = inverse mojood.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Mehdood quadratic function ka inverse nikalne ka tareeqa (hamari taraf se):
1. \(y = f(x)\) likhein aur \(x\), \(y\) ki jagah badlein.
2. \(y\) ko quadratic formula (ya completing the square) se hal karein. Jawab \(y = \text{kuch} \pm \sqrt{\ldots}\) ki shakal mein aayega.
3. Domain \(f\) aur Range \(f\) nikaalein. Phir Domain \(f^{-1}\) = Range \(f\), aur Range \(f^{-1}\) = Domain \(f\).
4. Woh sign rakhein jis ke outputs Range \(f^{-1}\) mein hon. Aam tor par \(x \ge h\) ho to \(+\) sign, aur \(x \le h\) ho to \(-\) sign.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Ek misaal se inverse ka khayal pakka kar lijiye. Maan lijiye ek dukaan mein har cheez ki qeemat ka rule hai "pehle 2 jama karo, phir square karo, phir 1 ghatao", yani \(f(x) = (x + 2)^{2} - 1\), jo hamara hi function \(x^{2} + 4x + 3\) hai. Inverse ka kaam ulta safar hai: aakhri qadam pehle aur ulti shakal mein. Pehle 1 jama karo, phir square root lo, phir 2 ghatao: \(f^{-1}(x) = \sqrt{x + 1} - 2\). Dekhiye, yeh bilkul wahi jawab hai jo Example 4 mein quadratic formula se nikalta hai!
Lekin square root wale qadam par ek faisla karna parta hai: \(\sqrt{\ }\) ka positive hissa lein ya negative? Isi liye domain mehdood kiya jata hai. Agar \(x + 2 \ge 0\) ho (yani \(x \ge -2\)) to positive root, aur agar \(x + 2 \le 0\) ho to negative root.
Graph ki zabaan mein: \(f^{-1}\) ka graph \(f\) ke graph ka line \(y = x\) mein aks (reflection, aaine wali tasveer) hota hai. Vertex \((-2, -1)\) aks ban kar \((-1, -2)\) ho jata hai, aur waqai \(f^{-1}(-1) = -2 + \sqrt{0} = -2\).

blocks.title: Example 4
blocks.problem: Find the inverse of \(f(x) = x^{2} + 4x + 3,\ x \ge -2\). Also find its domain and range.
steps:
Given: \(f(x) = x^{2} + 4x + 3\), aur domain mehdood (restricted) hai: \(x \ge -2\).
To find: \(f^{-1}(x)\), aur \(f\) aur \(f^{-1}\) dono ka domain aur range.
Method: sab se pehle hum dekhte hain ke inverse ka matlab kya hai: aisa function jo \(f\) ka kaam ulta kar de. Is liye \(y = f(x)\) likh kar \(x\) aur \(y\) ki jagah badlenge, aur nayi equation ko \(y\) ke liye hal karenge. Yeh equation \(y\) mein quadratic hogi, is liye quadratic formula lagega. Formula do sign dega (\(\pm\)); sahi sign ka faisla domain aur range karenge.

Step 1: \(y\) likhein aur \(x\), \(y\) ki jagah badlein
\[y = x^{2} + 4x + 3\]
\[x = y^{2} + 4y + 3\]
\[y^{2} + 4y + 3 - x = 0\]
Kyun: \(f\) input \(x\) le kar output \(y\) deta hai. Inverse ko ulta kaam karna hai: output le kar input wapas dena. \(x\) aur \(y\) ki jagah badalna bilkul yahi baat likhna hai. Phir sab terms ek taraf le aaye taa ke quadratic equation ki standard shakal ban jaye.

Step 2: \(y\) ke liye quadratic formula
Yahan \(a = 1\), \(b = 4\), \(c = 3 - x\):
\[y = \dfrac{-4 \pm \sqrt{(4)^{2} - 4(1)(3 - x)}}{2(1)}\]
Kyun: equation \(y^{2} + 4y + (3 - x) = 0\) \(y\) mein quadratic hai. Is waqt \(x\) ko ek aam number samjhiye; is liye poora \(3 - x\) constant term \(c\) hai.
Dhyan dein: \(c = 3\) likh dena aur \(-x\) bhool jana bohat aam ghalti hai; phir jawab mein \(x\) aata hi nahi.

Step 3: Square root ke andar simplify karein
\[y = \dfrac{-4 \pm \sqrt{16 - 12 + 4x}}{2}\]
\[y = \dfrac{-4 \pm \sqrt{4 + 4x}}{2}\]
\[y = \dfrac{-4 \pm 2\sqrt{1 + x}}{2}\]
Kyun: \(-4(3 - x) = -12 + 4x\) (minus bracket ke dono terms par lagta hai). Phir \(4 + 4x = 4(1 + x)\), aur \(\sqrt{4} = 2\) bahar aa jata hai: \(\sqrt{4(1 + x)} = 2\sqrt{1 + x}\).

Step 4: 2 se divide karein aur \(y\) ki jagah \(f^{-1}(x)\) likhein
\[f^{-1}(x) = -2 \pm \sqrt{1 + x}\]
Kyun: numerator ke dono terms 2 se divide hote hain: \(-4/2 = -2\) aur \(2\sqrt{1+x}/2 = \sqrt{1+x}\). Ab is mein ek positive aur ek negative hissa (component) hai. Function ke do jawab nahi ho sakte, is liye inverse sirf ek hi ho sakta hai. Kaun sa? Yeh dekhne ke liye pehle diye gaye function ka domain aur range nikaalte hain.

Step 5: \(f\) ka domain
\[\text{Domain } f = [-2, \infty)\]
Kyun: sawal mein hi \(x \ge -2\) diya gaya hai. Yeh \(-2\) koi ittefaq nahi: vertex ka \(x\)-coordinate \(h = -\frac{4}{2(1)} = -2\) hai. Vertex se aage sirf ek baazu bachta hai, jahan function one-to-one hai.

Step 6: \(f\) ki range
Completing the square se:
\[f(x) = x^{2} + 4x + 3\]
\[f(x) = (x + 2)^{2} - 1\]
Ab \(x \ge -2\) hai, to \(x + 2 \ge 0\). Is liye \((x + 2)^{2}\) zero aur us se bari har value leta hai, aur \(f(x) \ge -1\). Matlab \(f(x)\) ki minimum value \(-1\) hai, aur
\[\text{Range } f = [-1, \infty)\]
Kyun: vertex form seedha sab se neechi value dikha deta hai: vertex \((-2, -1)\) hai aur \(a = 1 > 0\), yani parabola upar khulta hai. (Kitab yahan pehle ek aur tareeqa likhti hai jo durust nahi; neeche "Kitab ki ghalti" dekhiye.)

Step 7: \(f^{-1}\) ka domain aur range
\[\text{Domain } f^{-1} = [-1, \infty)\]
\[\text{Range } f^{-1} = [-2, \infty)\]
Kyun: inverse input aur output ki jagah badal deta hai, is liye Domain \(f^{-1}\) = Range \(f\) aur Range \(f^{-1}\) = Domain \(f\). Ek aur tasdeeq: \(\sqrt{1 + x}\) ke liye \(1 + x \ge 0\) zaroori hai, yani \(x \ge -1\). Wahi domain!
Dhyan dein: exam mein chaaron cheezein alag alag likhiye (Domain \(f\), Range \(f\), Domain \(f^{-1}\), Range \(f^{-1}\)). Bohat se students sirf \(f^{-1}(x)\) likh kar ruk jate hain, jab ke sawal domain aur range bhi maang raha hai, aur in ke number alag milte hain.

Step 8: Sahi sign chunein
Ab domain mein se koi bhi value lein; hum \(x = 0\) lete hain.
\[f^{-1}(0) = -2 + \sqrt{1 + 0} = -1\]
\[f^{-1}(0) = -2 - \sqrt{1 + 0} = -3\]
Sirf \(-1\) range of \(f^{-1}\), yani \([-2, \infty)\), mein aata hai; \(-3\) nahi aata. Is liye negative component chhor dete hain.
Kyun: \(f^{-1}\) ka har output \(f\) ka input hona chahiye, yani \(-2\) ya us se bara number. \(-3 < -2\) hai, is liye minus wala hissa inverse nahi ho sakta.

Step 9: Nateeja
\[f^{-1}(x) = -2 + \sqrt{1 + x}\]
Kyun: plus sign ke saath \(\sqrt{1 + x} \ge 0\), is liye \(f^{-1}(x) \ge -2\) har \(x\) ke liye; bilkul wahi jo range chahti thi.

Tasdeeq:
\(f(1) = 1 + 4 + 3 = 8\), aur \(f^{-1}(8) = -2 + \sqrt{9} = 1\). Yani \(f\) ne 1 ko 8 banaya aur \(f^{-1}\) ne 8 ko wapas 1 bana diya. Yahi inverse ka kaam hai.
Aam tor par bhi: \(f(f^{-1}(x)) = (-2 + \sqrt{1 + x})^{2} + 4(-2 + \sqrt{1 + x}) + 3\)
\[= 4 - 4\sqrt{1+x} + 1 + x\]
\[\quad - 8 + 4\sqrt{1+x} + 3 = x\]

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Range nikalte waqt kitab likhti hai: "\(x \ge -2\), is liye \(x^{2} \ge +4\)". Yeh durust nahi. Misaal: \(x = 0\) bhi \(-2\) se bara hai, lekin \(0^{2} = 0\), jo 4 se bara nahi. Inequality ke dono taraf ka square sirf tab le sakte hain jab dono taraf non-negative hon. Sahi daleel wahi hai jo kitab is ke baad deti hai aur jo hum ne Step 6 mein likhi: \(f(x) = (x + 2)^{2} - 1\) aur \(x + 2 \ge 0\), is liye \(f(x) \ge -1\). Nateeja, Range \(f = [-1, \infty)\), sahi hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein doosri line \(f^{-1}(0) = +2 - \sqrt{1 - 0} = -3\) chhapi hai. Negative component \(-2 - \sqrt{1 + x}\) hai, is liye sahi line \(f^{-1}(0) = -2 - \sqrt{1 + 0} = -3\) hai. (Jaisi chhapi hai, \(+2 - \sqrt{1 - 0}\) ki value to \(1\) banti hai, \(-3\) nahi.) Value \(-3\) aur aakhri nateeja durust hain. Kitab yeh bhi kehti hai ke \(-1\) "range of \(f\)" mein hai; yeh bhi sach hai, lekin asal mein muqabla range of \(f^{-1}\), yani \([-2, \infty)\), se hona chahiye.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Agar isi function ka domain \(x \le -2\) hota to inverse kaun sa hota?
Jawab: ab Range \(f^{-1}\) = Domain \(f\) = \((-\infty, -2]\). Plus wala hissa \(-2\) ya us se bari values deta hai, is liye ab minus wala hissa sahi hai: \(f^{-1}(x) = -2 - \sqrt{1 + x}\). Misaal: \(f(-3) = 0\) aur \(-2 - \sqrt{1} = -3\). Sahi!

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh hamari practice hai, kitab ka sawal nahi: \(f(x) = x^{2} - 2x,\ x \ge 1\).
\(x = y^{2} - 2y\), yani \(y^{2} - 2y - x = 0\). Quadratic formula: \(y = \frac{2 \pm \sqrt{4 + 4x}}{2} = 1 \pm \sqrt{1 + x}\).
Domain \(f = [1, \infty)\); \(f(x) = (x - 1)^{2} - 1\), is liye Range \(f = [-1, \infty)\).
Range \(f^{-1}\) = \([1, \infty)\), is liye plus sign: \(f^{-1}(x) = 1 + \sqrt{1 + x}\).
Tasdeeq: \(f(3) = 9 - 6 = 3\), aur \(f^{-1}(3) = 1 + \sqrt{4} = 3\). Sahi!

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Quadratic function poori real line par one-to-one nahi; use \(x \ge h\) ya \(x \le h\) tak mehdood karein.
2. \(f^{-1}\) ke liye: \(x\) aur \(y\) badlein, phir \(y\) ko quadratic formula se hal karein.
3. Domain \(f^{-1}\) = Range \(f\); Range \(f^{-1}\) = Domain \(f\).
4. Range \(f\) vertex form \(a(x - h)^{2} + k\) se nikaalein.
5. \(\pm\) mein se woh sign rakhein jis ki values Range \(f^{-1}\) mein hon, aur \(f(f^{-1}(x)) = x\) se check karein.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Dono sign rakh lena: \(-2 \pm \sqrt{1 + x}\) function nahi hai; inverse sirf ek sign wala hissa hai.
2. Inequality ka seedha square le lena, jaise \(x \ge -2 \Rightarrow x^{2} \ge 4\): jab ek taraf negative ho sakti ho to yeh ghalat hai.
3. Quadratic formula mein \(c = 3\) likhna: constant term poora \(3 - x\) hai.
4. \(f^{-1}\) ka domain aur range ulat dena: yeh \(f\) ki range aur domain hain, jagah badal kar.
5. Square root ka sharti hissa bhool jana: \(\sqrt{1 + x}\) ke liye \(x \ge -1\) zaroori hai.
